purpose: Stop new simulated investments when reserves are depleted and a required payment exceeded liquid funds available before payment.

inputs.oneMeans: A required payment (essential surprise or installment) exceeded cash plus reserves available before payment

output.zeroMeans: Stop new investments until the emergency reserve is refilled
output.oneMeans: STOP condition inactive; not an investment recommendation

designVerification.note: All four input combinations verified with eval(uint256,bytes) on X Layer. Runtime verifies chain, owner, shape and truth table. Current game reads are downloadable with calldata, block number and raw output.

integration.failureBehavior: No gameplay mutation is committed when the circuit read fails; new investment controls remain locked until verification succeeds.
